items.question: What is RAVU Ltd?
items.answer: RAVU Ltd is a Dar es Salaam company building a membership for motorcycle (boda boda) riders, Bajaj operators, private vehicle owners, commercial drivers, truck and bus operators and fleet owners. Members get discounted insurance, spare parts and garage services from RAVU partners.

items.question: Who can become a RAVU member?
items.answer: RAVU serves six core mobility categories: (A) Motorcycle & Boda Boda Riders, (B) Bajaj (Three-Wheeler) & Commercial Vehicle Operators, (C) Private Motor Vehicle Owners & Member Households, (D) Truck Owners & Logistics Companies, (E) Bus Owners & Passenger Transport Companies, and (F) Commercial & Corporate Fleet Owners.

items.question: What discounts do members receive on insurance?
items.answer: Verified members get up to 30% off standard premiums across 8 types of cover (Motorcycle, Bajaj, Private Motor Vehicle, Commercial Fleet, Personal Accident, Health & Medical, Life & Family Protection, and SME Business Protection), plus reduced deductibles, priority claims, flexible payment plans and roadside assistance where the insurer offers them.

items.question: What discounts do members receive on spare parts and garage services?
items.answer: Verified RAVU members receive up to 25% off genuine spare parts, tires, batteries, lubricants, filters and accessories, plus up to 20% off routine maintenance, engine servicing, suspension, brakes, electrical diagnostics and wheel alignment at participating garages. Commercial fleets also qualify for the RAVU Fleet Discount Program with volume-based bulk pricing and priority service bay booking.

items.question: How does the Dar es Salaam pilot work?
items.answer: New insurance and service partnerships launch through a 4–6 month pilot in Dar es Salaam with an initial cohort of 200–500 active verified riders, drivers and vehicle owners. The pilot measures member utilization, discount effectiveness and service turnaround before scaling nationwide.

items.question: How can an organization partner with RAVU?
items.answer: Insurers, spare parts suppliers, mechanical garages, tire & battery centers, fuel stations and financial institutions can register directly via the Partner Registration page or contact Saleh Nyindo (Founder & CEO, RAVU Ltd, Dar es Salaam) at nyindo@posteo.de.

assist.title: Need direct assistance?
assist.text: Whether you are registering interest as a member or onboarding as a business partner, our team is ready to guide you.
